source_quotes.psu: Penn State Extension, Brown Marmorated Stink Bug: Adults begin to search for overwintering sites starting in September through October. / attracted to the outside of houses on warm fall days in search of protected, overwintering sites and can enter houses in large numbers. / If many of them are crushed or sucked into a vacuum cleaner, their smell can be quite apparent. / the vacuum may acquire the smell of stink bugs for a period of time. / The stink bug will not reproduce inside structures or cause damage. / look for lighter bands on the antennae.
